title: Manager, Energy Analytics
description:
Meta's Infrastructure organization is seeking a Manager to lead energy analytics strategy for our global data center portfolio. As power demand grows by an order of magnitude over the coming years, energy cost and usage become increasingly material drivers of Meta's financial performance. In this role, you will lead a growing, geographically distributed team of experienced analysts responsible for developing the forecasting models and analytical frameworks that inform capacity planning, budgeting, procurement strategy, and rate design across Meta's data center infrastructure. As the portfolio continues to scale, this role carries increased ownership: setting standards across the team, developing experienced individual contributors and emerging leads, and serving as a primary energy analytics partner to Infrastructure and Finance leadership. You will also build the systems that quantify the portfolio's exposure to energy price and volume volatility across markets.  
  
  

### **Manager, Energy Analytics Responsibilities:**

* Lead and grow a team of energy analysts spanning data center portfolio analytics, clean and renewable projects, cost and rate analysis, and load and generation forecasting. Own hiring, onboarding, capacity planning, and team structure as the function scales
* Develop ICs and emerging team leads
* establish career pathways, calibration practices, and succession depth so the team's analytical capability is not concentrated in any single person
* Lead with accountability, transparency, and recognition, promoting continuous improvement and learning across the team
* Serve as an expert on energy rates and energy usage for Meta's growing global portfolio of data centers
* Own development and continuous improvement of models to forecast energy usage, generation, and cost, and to analyze electric rate impacts for current and future data center sites
* Set and enforce analytical standards across the team, covering methodology review, model documentation
